rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for a soldier, especially an enlisted one.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 bing1 zung6 mei6 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 軍人 when emphasizing military membership broadly, including officers, rather than a rank-specific 兵.

example.english: They have wanted to be a soldier since childhood.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都想做軍人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 soeng2 zou6 gwan1 jan4

rows.note: Use 戰士 for a fighting soldier or warrior, not for every enlisted service member.

example.english: In this film, the soldier charged out to save people.
example.traditional: 呢套戲入面，個戰士為咗救人衝咗出去。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 go3 zin3 si6 wai6 zo2 gau3 jan4 cung1 zo2 ceot1 heoi3
